runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON THE FLOOR
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the FY2025 10-K's Items 1, 1A and 7 (the regulatory record and the two late California rate cases; the capital programme against internally generated funds; inverse condemnation, the Rancho Palos Verdes land-movement suits, PFAS capital and purchased water; the ATM issuance; the 2022 material weakness and two corrections); competitors chosen by the analyst as a CONVENTION because the 10-K names only public agencies. Price **$47.82** (close 2026-10-27, aggregator, flagged) x **61,839,101 shares** (10-Q cover, quarter ended 2026-06-30, accession 0001628280-26-050990; one class; third-quarter ATM sales not in the count, stated) = cap **$2,957.1M**; sovereign **5.30%** (Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-27). **Q1 IN** (Cal Water $169.5M of $170.4M 2025 operating income; rate base times allowed return less lag). **Q2 IN on the regulated exception** (no private utility may compete without a certificate issued only on deficient service; CPUC 10.27% on equity, 53.4% equity and 46.6% debt, held by three extensions to May 2027; the 2024 case decided four months late at about $90.5M against $140.6M requested, the 2021 case fourteen months late; regulated return carried to Q3); ten-year average ROE CWT 8.8% against AWR 13.5%, AWK 11.0%, H2O America 7.6%. **Q3 weighs against** (about 6% after tax on total capital, 8% on equity; owner cash after all spending negative every year; EPS $1.96 to $2.15 2021 to 2025 while diluted shares went 51.6M to 59.6M). **Q4 IN on the accounts, weighs against mildly** (2022 material weakness over regulatory assets and liabilities, $11.1M immaterial restatement, remediated; 2023 cost-of-removal reclassification; no adjusted earnings or guidance). **Q5 IN on integrity, ability weighs against mildly** (CEO and chair combined since 2023; pay $6.88M in 2025, say-on-pay 67%; directors and officers about 1.0%; earned return below the same-regulator rival). **Q6 weighs against** (retention test fails on both legs, about $781M retained or raised 2021 to 2025 against a fall of about $136M in market value; 60% target payout while ATM stock is sold, shares about 27% up since February 2020; no buybacks; no all-stock deal). **Q7 OUT, on the floor and above the top of the range**: equity-only central (a regulated utility); owner cash FY2021 to FY2025 after the depreciation guess **$90.7M a year with deferred tax charged (central)**, $123.9M on cash tax beside, -$132.6M after all spending on cash tax; developer advances and contributions netted out of growth spending, a CONVENTION of the run; growth 6.34% a year, no cut under (f); growth spending $272.8M in year one to $474.3M in year ten; utility debt credit $119.6M a year at Cal Water's 46.6% allowed debt share (long-term debt rising $137.0M a year), binding. Value range **$22.60 to $27.66 a share equity-only (central)**, the growth case below the no-growth case; maintenance owner cash 3.07% of the market value at the price, 4.19% on cash tax; **fair price $9.43 equity-only, central**; cash tax $37.81 to $43.88, fair $17.01 beside; all-equity $12.28 to -$6.71, fair -$17.68, not positive; signed unclosed deals about -$4.08 a share beside. Facts after the stop recorded, not weighed. Balance sheet FY2016 to FY2025: assets $2,412M to $5,671M, funded by long-term debt $558M to $1,474M, about $513M of stock sold 2021 to 2025, developer money and deferred taxes; goodwill $37.1M; cash thin; pre-tax interest cover about 3.1x in 2025; debt to capitalization 48.8% under a 66.7% covenant. Strongest evidence against, as the analyst put it: never cash after compulsory spending and the 10-K expects that for five years; a ratio dividend funded by stock sales; retention fails; earned return well below allowed; strict-liability inverse condemnation in California with live landslide suits. Framework gaps for the operator: deferred taxes in a utility's owner cash, which move the central range by $10 to $21 a share; developer-funded plant against the debt credit; the debt-credit cap read as a share of growth spending; the retention test for a company that raises more than it retains; tools/run.py cannot read the tag PaymentsToAcquireWaterAndWasteWaterSystems, so every figure was built by hand. Could not get: the third-quarter 2026 10-Q (not yet filed); either deal target's earnings. Analyst's commits: pathspec commits of its own paths; Q1 alone, Q2 to Q6 drafted together after the shared owner-cash computation then committed one by one, Q7 and the close in the last commit `d2fd9fe3`, a partial departure from write-early declared in the self-audit. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, every id in the ledger, no citation slip, 32 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged; no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: AWR v5 run commit subjects with its box, range and fair price at session start (AWR used as a rival from its own SEC facts only), an ARCB folder name, daily digest names and memory index lines; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the equity-only fair price.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on the floor: a California water utility whose castle is the CPUC franchise, earning 8.8% on equity over ten years against an allowed 10.27% and its same-state rival's 13.5%, never producing cash after its compulsory spending and funding a ratio dividend by selling stock; maintenance owner cash 3.07% of the price; value range $22.60 to $27.66 equity-only against $47.82. Fair $9.43 equity-only, central; all-equity not positive; armed.
